gloss: hard to sleep; restless (due to heat)

definitions.gloss: hard to sleep; unable to sleep comfortably; restless
definitions.explanation: Describes a state where one cannot sleep well, typically because of heat, humidity, or uncomfortable conditions. Most often associated with hot summer nights.

examples.japanese: {寝苦|ねぐる}しい⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{暑|あつ}くて→暑い：00619_atsui⟧{寝苦|ねぐる}しい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: It was so hot I couldn't sleep, so I turned on the air conditioner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{湿度|しつど}→湿度：03181_shitsudo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}くて→高い：00500_takai⟧{寝苦|ねぐる}しい⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: During the rainy season, there are many nights where it's too humid to sleep well.

notes: Almost exclusively used to describe difficulty sleeping due to heat or humidity, especially during Japanese summers. The most common collocation is {寝苦|ねぐる}しい⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧ (a restless/sleepless night), frequently heard in weather forecasts: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{寝苦|ねぐる}しい⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧でしょう (Tonight will be another uncomfortable night for sleeping). Part of the ～{苦|ぐる}しい pattern meaning 'hard to do ~,' like ⟦{見苦|みぐる}しい→見苦しい：23219_migurushii⟧ (unsightly), {聞|きき}き{苦|ぐる}しい (unpleasant to hear).
